_comment: P(channel | country, sector), from distinct funded companies. Emitted by ETL/terms/emit_channel_prior.py. Cells with fewer than 40 observations are omitted; the reader backs off to country, then global. Every cell carries a value for every channel in `channels` except those in `unobserved`, so a key the reader does not find is a channel the corpus has never funded anybody through -- never one this cell merely missed.
